dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.lead: Dashboards show panels with your data, sorted into folders.
dashboards.empty.title: No dashboards yet
dashboards.empty.text: Dashboards you can open will appear here. Create one, or add a query from Explore to a new dashboard.
dashboards.empty.searchText: No dashboard title contains this text. Check the spelling or search in all folders.
dashboards.noOrg.title: No organization
dashboards.noOrg.text: Dashboards belong to an organization. Ask an admin to add you to one.
dashboards.forbidden.title: No access
dashboards.notFound.title: Dashboard not found
dashboards.notFound.text: It may have been deleted, or it is in a folder you have no access to.
dashboards.loadFailed: The dashboard could not be loaded
dashboards.new.title: New dashboard
dashboards.column.title: Title
dashboards.folders.label: Folders
dashboards.folders.name: Name
dashboards.folders.restrictedHint: Restricted: only members with access to this folder, admins and owners see it.
dashboards.folders.restrict: Restricted: visible only to members with access
dashboards.folders.deleteText: “{name}” moves to the trash together with its dashboards. You can restore it from there.
dashboards.trash.title: Trash
dashboards.trash.lead: Deleted folders and dashboards stay here until you delete them for good. Restoring a folder brings back everything deleted with it.
dashboards.trash.emptyText: Deleted folders and dashboards appear here.
dashboards.trash.forbidden: Only members who may delete dashboards see the trash.
dashboards.editing: Edit mode. Drag panels by their title or use the arrange button with the arrow keys.
dashboards.editingUnsaved: Edit mode, unsaved changes. Save to keep them as a new version.
dashboards.discard.title: Discard changes?
dashboards.discard.text: Your unsaved changes to this dashboard will be lost.
dashboards.settings.title: Dashboard settings
dashboards.save.title: Save dashboard
dashboards.save.messageHint: Shown in the history, so others know what this version is about.
dashboards.delete.title: Delete dashboard?
dashboards.delete.text: “{title}” moves to the trash. You can restore it from there.
dashboards.noPanels.title: No panels yet
dashboards.noPanels.text: Add a panel and pick a data source and a query for it.
dashboards.noPanels.textViewer: This dashboard has no panels yet.
dashboards.conflict.title: Someone else saved this dashboard
dashboards.conflict.text: Version {version} was saved while you were editing. Compare the changes, then choose which version to keep.
dashboards.conflict.theirs: Saved by others in the meantime
dashboards.conflict.overwrite: Save mine as the newest version
dashboards.conflict.overwriteMessage: Saved over a newer version after a conflict
dashboards.diff.title: Title changed from “{from}” to “{to}”
dashboards.history.title: History
dashboards.history.lead: Every save is a version. Restoring an older one saves it again as the newest version; nothing is lost.
dashboards.history.compareTitle: Changes from version {version} to the current version
dashboards.history.restoreText: Version {version} becomes the newest version. The current version stays in the history.
dashboards.history.emptyText: Versions appear here after the first save.
dashboards.panel.arrangeHint: Arrow keys move the panel, Shift and arrow keys resize it.
dashboards.panel.noQuery: This panel has no query yet.
dashboards.panel.unknownType: This panel type is not available: {type}.
dashboards.panel.otherShape: The result is in the shape “{shape}”, which this panel cannot show. Pick another visualization.
dashboards.panel.truncated: The result was cut off at the row limit of the data source.
dashboards.inspect.title: Inspect “{title}”
dashboards.inspect.empty: There is nothing to inspect yet. Run the query first.
dashboards.inspect.truncated: Cut off at the row limit of the data source. Narrow the query to see everything.
dashboards.editor.title: Edit panel
dashboards.editor.noDatasources: There is no data source to query yet. An admin adds them under Data sources.
dashboards.variables.label: Variables
dashboards.variables.hint: Variables let viewers change values in every query, such as a region. Queries use them as $name; they reach the database as parameters, never as text in the query.
dashboards.variables.name: Name
dashboards.variables.queryHint: The first column of the result becomes the list of values. Save the dashboard to use a changed query.
dashboards.variables.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
dashboards.variables.nameTaken: Another variable already has this name.
dashboards.time.title: Time range
dashboards.time.hint: Relative like now-6h, now-7d or now/d (start of today), or a date and time like 2026-10-20 08:00.
dashboards.time.error.invalidFrom: The start is not a time. Use something like now-6h or 2026-10-20 08:00.
dashboards.time.error.invalidTo: The end is not a time. Use something like now or 2026-10-20 18:00.
dashboards.time.error.fromAfterTo: The start has to be before the end.
dashboards.panels.empty.noTimeSeries: No time series in the result. A time series needs a time field and at least one number field.
dashboards.panels.empty.noValues: No number fields in the result.
dashboards.panels.unitHint: Shown after values, for example ms, % or EUR.
dashboards.panels.barsTruncated: Only the first {count} rows are shown as bars.
dashboards.panels.tableHint: Click a column header to sort. Empty cells have no value.
dashboards.inTrash: This dashboard is in the trash. Restore it to change it again.
dashboards.trash.name: Name
dashboards.trash.purgeText: “{title}” and all its versions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
dashboards.trash.purgeFolderText: “{title}” will be deleted with its subfolders, their dashboards and all versions. This cannot be undone.
